name: Conversion research planner
why: Sets the research order (where, what, why) before any test, matching the conversion-research-audit skill.

name: Sales funnel drop-off finder
why: Finds the worst drop-off step from pasted step numbers and screenshots, the first move in a research sprint.

name: Store page conversion reader
why: Reads GA4 exports into conversion by channel and page and the worst funnel drop, for store clients.

name: Heatmap and recording reader
why: Turns heatmap and recording notes into friction findings and test ideas, once consent and masking are checked.

name: Product page doubt mapper
why: Maps what buyers doubt to page sections backed by real proof, for product-page fixes.

name: Product page screenshot auditor
why: Quick read of what blocks shoppers from product page screenshots when there is no analytics access.

name: Payments and checkout settings checker
why: Checks payment and checkout settings for risks and friction, a common source of clear fix-now bugs.

name: A/B test traffic checker
why: Works out test size and weeks needed from visits and orders, to say early whether a test is feasible.

name: One-change experiment planner
why: Plans a test that changes one thing and says what each result means, alongside the test-design skill.

name: Experiment readout desk
why: Checks each test before it starts and gives an honest verdict when it ends, with the lesson saved to the log.

name: Weekly product funnel watcher
why: Weekly read of product events for the step that lost the most and one experiment to run, for software clients.

name: Landing page fix loop
why: Audits a landing page, rewrites what fails and checks again, for pages too low in traffic to test.
